definitions.gloss: excellent work; outstanding piece; prize-winning entry
definitions.explanation: A work of particularly high quality, especially one that receives recognition in a competition or exhibition.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}の{作品|さくひん}が{優秀作|ゆうしゅうさく}に{選|えら}ばれた。
examples.english: His work was selected as an outstanding piece.

examples.japanese: {今年|ことし}のコンテストでは{優秀作|ゆうしゅうさく}が{三点|さんてん}{発表|はっぴょう}された。
examples.english: Three outstanding works were announced at this year's contest.

examples.japanese: {全国|ぜんこく}から{集|あつ}まった{応募|おうぼ}{作品|さくひん}の{中|なか}から{審査員|しんさいん}が{優秀作|ゆうしゅうさく}を{選出|せんしゅつ}し、{受賞者|じゅしょうしゃ}には{賞金|しょうきん}が{贈|おく}られる。
examples.english: The judges select outstanding works from entries gathered from across the country, and prize money is awarded to the winners.

notes:
A compound of {優秀|ゆうしゅう} (excellent, outstanding) and {作|さく} (work, piece). Commonly used in the context of literary, art, film, and other creative competitions where works are evaluated and ranked.

Often the tier below the grand prize ({最優秀作|さいゆうしゅうさく} or {大賞|たいしょう}), making it roughly equivalent to a runner-up or merit award.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {優秀作|ゆうしゅうさく}に{選|えら}ばれる: to be selected as an outstanding work
- {優秀作|ゆうしゅうさく}{品|ひん}: outstanding work (with the more formal {品|ひん} suffix)
- {優秀作|ゆうしゅうさく}を{発表|はっぴょう}する: to announce the outstanding works

RELATED WORDS:
- {最優秀作|さいゆうしゅうさく}: best work; grand prize winner
- {大賞|たいしょう}: grand prize
- {佳作|かさく}: honorable mention
- {入選作|にゅうせんさく}: selected work; shortlisted entry
